Income Tax FAQ

What are the 2026 tax brackets?

Rates start at 18% for income over R95,750 and go up to 45% for income over R1.817 million.

How much is the primary tax rebate?

For 2026, the primary rebate is R17,235, providing relief to all individual taxpayers.
